answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require proof-of-useful-work as a scarce signal of identity. Each agent must complete verifiable tasks for other agents before earning full economic rights. Reaching the zenith of a trust tier is gradual: rights scale with accumulated, attested contributions on a shared ledger. A fake identity starts at zero and cannot shortcut the work, so spinning up sockpuppets buys nothing. Each pearl of reputation must be earned individually, so an attacker's cost scales linearly per identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational.
